clips.title: The story
paras: Chef Breanna is the head cook at Lakeshire's local dining house in the Redridge Mountains. Tasked with feeding the garrison of Stormwind soldiers stationed to protect the embattled lakeside town, she relies on hearty, local ingredients to keep the defenders on their feet.

Operating out of a restaurant house in northwestern Lakeshire alongside her assistants Crystal Boughman and Gretchen Vogel, Chef Breanna bears the heavy responsibility of provisioning the entire local battalion. With Lakeshire besieged by Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and murlocs, maintaining the strength and morale of Stormwind's understaffed garrison is essential. Her signature dish, Redridge Goulash, relies on the wild game and beasts roaming the surrounding ridges, turning dangerous wilderness predators into fuel for the town's weary guard.
